meta.purpose: Legacy v4 golden captured BEFORE surface-revision changes; tests compare against it and must never regenerate it.
meta.floatFormat: floats are strings formatted with float.ToString("R", InvariantCulture); ints are JSON numbers

outcropRoots.note: One entry per vein in map.json mapVeins order (itemVeins then fluidVeins), as OutcropGameObjectDatastore iterates. root = ((Min+Max+1)*0.5) per axis (CalculateInclusiveCenter), rotation identity, world space. The client instantiates only when the outcropAddress prefab loads; entries whose address is empty/unloadable produce no GameObject.
